fact_previews: The game 'Handscoped' delivers a new take on competitiveness in FPS games.
In 'Handscoped', each weapon has a different playstyle that favors different aspects of combat.
More powerful guns in 'Handscoped' tend to have larger recoil, affecting accuracy, stability, and comfort.
Maps in 'Handscoped' are designed for opposing teams to face each other, with cover that can be either partial or exposed.
Players must learn the strengths and weaknesses of locations on all maps in 'Handscoped'.

fact_previews: The game 'Handscoped' is designed to be a first-person shooter (FPS) where the phone acts as the controller.
Movement in 'Handscoped' is simplified to be intuitive, focusing primarily on aiming.
Players can move only left and right along a line defined by the map, with some maps featuring curved paths or slopes.
Tilting the phone sideways allows the character to move until the player stops tilting.
The movement design allows for repositioning, hiding behind cover, and dodging enemy fire.

fact_previews: The alpha for the game 'Handscoped' is planned to start around 4-5 months after a successful Kickstarter campaign.
The goal is to invite the majority of backers of all tiers to alpha testing.
The release date for later testing phases depends on the bugs and requests from the testers of the first alpha.
The main goals of the alpha are to test the novel controls, server stability, general gameplay flow, and latency, as well as to find bugs.
There will be a limited number of playable maps during the alpha playtesting.
